title: Send this One Simple Email Request to the Hotel 5 Days Before Your Arrive at the Hotel for Check in.
description:
Confession: We almost always get hotel welcome treats, exclusive perks and amazing freebies.. Would you like to know how?

Okay, parents — imagine this. You’ve just booked your dream family trip. 🏖️ The kids are already arguing about who gets the window seat. You’re counting down the days, picturing that first dip in the hotel pool. 🏊‍♀️

But here’s the thing most people don’t know… 🤫
There’s ONE simple email you can send 5 days before your trip that can completely change your hotel experience.

I’m talking about free upgrades, welcome snacks, early check-in, late checkout, and sometimes even little surprises for the kids — like stuffed toys or dessert plates with their names on them! 🍪🎁

Yep, all from one polite, well-written email. 💌

Here’s a fun fact: Hotels actually set aside rooms every week for VIPs, influencers, and loyalty members… but when those aren’t taken, friendly families who reach out the right way often get first dibs. 😉

We’ve done this in Singapore, Japan, Bali, and even Disneyland — and guess what? It worked almost every time! 🏰✈️

Because kindness (and good timing) really goes a long way in hospitality. 💖

Want to get the exact email script we send to hotels to get upgrades, perks, and freebies?

👇 Comment HOTEL and we’ll send it to you!
